notes.title: Regarding Gameplay and Performance Issue
notes.notes:
Due to a lack of explanation, some players might find it hard to clear the game. Here we provide you with some concepts and tips on how to play through the game.

This game's concept is a "NO-HINT" game, which focuses on trial and error. Let's say you find a doll, touch it, and then die when you walk away from it. Next time, you might try a different approach, like ignoring it. If you don't die in the same place anymore, it means the clear condition for that part is to "ignore it." Sometimes there are signs, and you need to interpret and possibly follow them.

We know that this game might trigger frustration, with thoughts like "Why the hell am I dying?" or "What the f*ck should I do?" But again, this is a NO-HINT game. So, be patient, be aware, be cautious of your surroundings, and never give up!

As for the performance issues, we're an indie game studio, so we don't have enough resources to test the game on a wide range of machines. This might result in bad performance on some devices. However, you can adjust the settings to make the game run smoother. Here are the recommended settings if your PC performance is not good enough:

Change the graphic quality from the settings screen:
There's not much difference between each quality level in terms of details, but we guarantee that the FPS will increase if you change to a lower quality level.

Change the screen resolution and refresh rate:
Switching to a lower resolution will boost performance. Regarding the monitor refresh rate, you might need to turn off the V-Sync option and restart your game.

Please feel free to contact us via Discord if you have any questions.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Early Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102129/845fb42aaf41ab32833d0e5c3e5a96326bdae191.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We have some exciting news to share with you. Our indie game, [b]Light[/b], is ready earlier than we anticipated. Instead of the previously announced release date, we’re thrilled to let you know that the game will be available sooner!

New Release Date: August 1st, 2024 (JST)

We couldn’t have achieved this without your amazing support and encouragement. Our small team has put in a lot of love and effort to bring you this game, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

Thank you for being with us on this journey. Mark your calendars and get ready to explore the world of [b]Light[/b] a bit earlier than expected.

Happy gaming!

Warm regards,
The Light Development Team
